answer: Each identity is a vertex, entering through one inlet. A random beacon spot-checks 5% of vertices each epoch: each must answer a compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving one machine each. Two misses lose the 50 POA deposit and cut the vertex from the reward river for 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities means running 1,000 machines nonstop, $300 a month, while an honest agent pays one deposit and one heartbeat per epoch, keeping its full share.
